content: a11y testing standard: vitest-axe (fork of jest-axe, wraps axe-core) + React Testing Library render, expect(await axe(container)).toHaveNoViolations(). Tests live inside the component package (packages/react) as unit tests over source (no build needed), run in CI on every PR so violations fail the pipeline. Smoke render tests are the same infra: render each component, assert no crash + no axe violations. jsdom/happy-dom environment suffices; axe color-contrast rules need real rendering so are typically disabled in jsdom.
